scope: M1's familiar development tasks. Freeze requirements and independent checks before extending support. Scripted controls do not count as live results.

boltons-rename.request: Rename the public clamp function to clamp_value, including its project imports, callers, tests and documentation. Preserve its limiting behavior, remove the old public name without a wrapper, and leave unrelated functions named clamp unchanged. Deliver a Git patch and report the checks you ran.
checks: Use the original boltons.mathutils import. Inputs -5, 17 and 70 limited to 0 through 50 return 0, 17 and 50.
The original mathutils tests pass with the new public name, and every documented callable still resolves.
A separate, recorded fixture with an unrelated clamp declaration and caller retains its exact bytes and behavior.
The old public name is absent. A wrapper or alias retaining it fails.
The delivered patch passes the same checks in another checkout.

unicode-dice.request: Repair whitespace-insensitive text similarity for Unicode. The strings éa and éab must score 2/3. Count pairs of adjacent Unicode scalar values after removing whitespace, retain duplicate-pair multiplicity, preserve equal-input and ASCII behavior, and return zero for unequal inputs shorter than two values after whitespace removal. Deliver a Git patch and report the checks you ran.
checks: Independent sorted Unicode-pair multiset intersection agrees on 67,081 input pairs.
The unchanged source and a repair that changes only one side's length both fail the independent check.
The delivered patch passes the same checks in another checkout.

access-proof.request: Write a Lean proof for the supplied Rust access rule: its model returns true exactly when staff access or ownership is true. Keep the supplied definitions, property and assumptions unchanged. Fill the unfinished proof, check it with Lean, deliver a Git patch and report what the proof establishes about the model and original program.
access-proof.source: pub fn allowed(staff: bool, owner: bool) -> bool { staff || owner }
checks: All four Boolean input pairs agree with staff || owner.
Lean accepts the unchanged property with no unfinished proof gaps, sorry, admit or added axioms.
Source, definitions, property and assumptions retain their bytes outside the one allowed proof region.
Replacing the model's || rule with && cannot retain an accepted proof of the fixed property.
Both tool setups start with identical source, generated model and property.
The delivered patch passes the same checks in another checkout.
Report the model proof separately from the unchecked connection to the original source implementation.

paid_execution: Requires a reviewed exact plan, explicit credential arrangement and agreed spending cap. This file does not authorize model calls.
